title: ANALYSIS: The Housing Affordability Crisis
summary: A housing interview excerpt examines wages, mortgage rates, land costs, zoning, impact fees and possible federal policy responses. It ends with the institutional pressures on a bearish sell-side analyst before the financial crisis.
assessment: The full interview review evaluates the guest affordability figures, FHA claims and policy proposals with their qualifications. Eisman asks for concrete mechanisms and explains loan-to-value; this edited publication does not create an additional independent housing forecast.
framework_points: Reduce affordability to income, price and financing cost.
Identify whether a bottleneck is federal, local or economic.
Account for institutional incentives that discourage dissent.
